title: eQTL results - TUBE
bodyHtml:
Welcome to our gene browser page!

Below you will find a Manhattan plot for the specified genomic region and gene followed by the corresponding results table. 
There are multiple ways to filter results on this page. All applied filters will also filter table results.

Apply filters to Manhattan plot by using drop-down menu below: The results can be filtered by P-value (MatrixEQTL) or posterior inclusion probability (sPIP) and/or independent eQTL clusters (DAP-G). You can also filter variants by their presence in open chromatin peaks ("X" = in open chromatin, "." = in closed chromatin). 

PT = proximal tubule, LH = loop of Henle, DCT = distal convoluted tubule , CNT = connecting tubule, PC = principal cells, ICA = type A intercalated cells, ICB = type B intercalated cells, ENDO = endothelial cells, LEUK = leukocytes

dataTableLegendHtml:
1. "Filter associated variants by credible sets" to filter the results table and view DAP-G results. This will display a credible set viewer (similar to the Manhattan plot, except that y-axis is the posterior probability) aligned to the Manhattan plot.   
  2. "Filter associated variants by annotations" to filter the results table and view annotation tracks. This will display cell-type-specific genomic tracks, ATAC-seq peaks and/or deltaSVM scores, aligned to the Manhattan plot. Alignment of all starred variants will be represented by a yellow dashed line.   

Below, click on the column headers of the result table to sort.

  • Beta and P-value are from MatrixEQTL single-SNP association. 
    • Note: The alternate allele is the effect allele. For example, if Ref/Alt="A/G" and beta>0, then the G allele is associated with increased expression of the gene; if beta<0, the G allele is associated with decreased expression. 
  • To display fine-mapping results (SNP PIP (PPA), cluster PIP, cluster assignment, and cluster R2), click "View" under "Evidence."
  • ATAC(union) = 1 if the variant is ANY open chromatin peak. To view all open chromatin and deltaSVM annotations for a SNP, click "View" under "Evidence". 
  • For the deltaSVM, higher absolute scores indicate predicted more functional. |deltaSVM|>=1.0, 1.5, and 2.0 correspond to 64, 82, and 91 percentiles, respectively.
  • To view all genes associated with a variant, click the variant.

dataVisualizerLegendHtml:
• Manhattan plot with linkage disequilibrium (LD; 1000 EUR genomes reference).
  • Use green bars to the right to adjust the plotted region. 
  • For more information on the SNP, click on the SNP in the plot. From here, you can mark the SNP with a star or select "default" to make the SNP the LD reference point.
